description: A finite set of propositional premises fails to entail a conclusion if and only if there exists a countervaluation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.not_entails_iff_countervaluation.{u} {α : Type u}
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α))
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Entails Γ A ↔
    ∃ v, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Countervaluation v Γ A
